spans.s:
mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गं)
1 High, elevated, lofty.
2 Chief, principal.
3 Passionate, hot.
m. (-ङ्गः)
1 A tree, (Rottleria tinctoria.)
2 A mountain.
3 The planet

The superior apsis or aphelion of a planet.
5 Top, vertex, altitude.
6 The cocoanut tree.
f. (-ङ्गी)
1 A kind of basil, (Ocymum gratissimum.)
2

Night.
f. (-ङ्गा)
Bambu manna.
E.
तुजि to guard, to dwell, to hurt, &c. affix घञ्.

m. (-कः)
A tree, (Rottleria tinctoria.)
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

Passionateness.
E.
तल् added to तुङ्ग; also with त्व, तुङ्गत्व.

m. (-द्रः)
A restive elephant or one in rut.
f. (-द्रा)
A river in the Mysur country, the Toombhadra.
E.
तुङ्ग lofty, tall, &c. and भद्र auspicious.

m. (-रः)
A mountain.
E.
तुङ्ग lofty, and शेखर crest or summit.

mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि)
High, lofty.
m. (-ङ्गी)
A planet at the apex of its orbit, or of its position, with regard to others considered astrologically.
E.
तुङ्ग, and इनि aff.

m. (-तिः)
The moon.
E.
तुङ्गी night, and पति master.

The moon.
3 The sun.
4 A name of KṚṢṆA.
E.
तुङ्गी night, or तुङ्ग a mountain, &c. and ईश lord.
